summary: The delivery audit re-read the seven criteria whose behavior runs through the one implementation file changed since the last clean audit (src/engine/development-owners.ts, the Mark complete fix), at commit 5eeabe2; the other nine keep their Implemented status. Two rounds of fresh assessors ran; the first confirmed two gaps and the second found none new. AC-LOOP-05 is partly built: a delivery limit lowered just before a phase launches lets that loop run uncounted. AC-STOP-01 is partly built: the loop stop page says nothing about what an unresolved audit session did. Phase 2 was added to build both.
